_comment: Shape of the single Localization task (ref = "localization").
Seed with run-task if the task does not exist yet, extend with
modify-task + deep_merge:true — a shallow write to a text_id whose value
is a language map silently drops every language you did not send.
Keys are text_id values passed to Send Message. Inner keys are the
language codes stored on User Profile.language; "en" is the fallback the
template applies when the profile has no language.
{{someField}} interpolates from the task Send Message was called with --
so the CALLING command must forward that field in its api_copy data block:
the call is group:"" and sends nothing else, and an unforwarded value
renders as a literal {{someField}} in the chat.
{{t'someKey}} interpolates from this document, for shared phrases. NO DOT:
Send Message strips the literal "{{t'" prefix, so {{t'.someKey}} looks up
".someKey", misses, and leaves the placeholder visible. The regex that
matches the token has an unescaped dot, which is why the wrong form looks
like it works.
WARNING: of the five keys in the first block the wizard actually ships
only mainMenu, commandNotFound, timeout and selectError. It does NOT ship
serviceError, which both skeletons hardcode on every error and timeout
path -- seed it or every failure delivers an empty message. It also ships
keys the skeletons never use (404, inputError, yes, no, next, prev, page,
of, nextPage, prevPage, select). Always read the live document with
show-task before deciding what to seed: this file is a template, not an
inventory of any particular build.
The wizard seeds en, ru and uk regardless of the lang passed to it, and
Send Message picks the language from User Profile.language, which the
channel receiver derives from the client locale -- so seed every language
the document already has, not just the one requested.
The second block is the per-command pattern.

mainMenu.en: What would you like to do?

commandNotFound.en: I don't know that command yet.

timeout.en: We stopped waiting for your reply.
timeout.uk: Ми більше не чекаємо на відповідь.

serviceError.en: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
serviceError.uk: Щось зламалось на нашому боці. Спробуйте ще раз.

selectError.en: That is not one of the options.
